sources.title: turintech/gemma-4-E2B-it-Artemis-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Download gemma-4-E2B-it-Artemis-2.3GB.gguf (2.31 GB) and run it with llama.cpp's chat server, as in Run it. It predicts the same next token as the original 95.8% of the time and loses 3 of 16 maths questions in our task sample.

sources.title: Gemma 4 on a phone-sized budget: E2B in 2.3 GB, E4B in 4.2 GB
sources.snippet: Six everyday prompts We gave the original E2B (the 9.3 GB BF16 conversion of Google's QAT checkpoint) and our default and smallest E2B files, gemma-4-E2B-it-Artemis-2.3GB.gguf and gemma-4-E2B-it-Artemis-2.1GB.gguf, the same six prompts: the kind of thing someone might ask a model on their phone. All three ran on a desktop CPU (AMD Ryzen 9 9950X) with llama.cpp 1e6f04a, greedy decoding and ...
